title: Revenue Cycle Rule - Immunization Services Credit for Kestrel-Reported Doses
content:
**Kestrel Revenue Cycle - Immunization Services: crediting Kestrel's own doses to a resumed course**

**Rule.** When a patient resumes a series on a new course of an Immunization Services vaccination, Kestrel's own doses on the earlier course are credited as follows, counting the doses Kestrel reported to the state registry within the credit window. Where Kestrel reported at least one dose and the patient's insurance plans show at least as many paid claims as reported doses, every reported dose is credited. Where Kestrel reported at least one dose and the plans show fewer paid claims than reported doses, only as many reported doses as there are paid claims are credited. Where Kestrel reported no dose, no Kestrel dose is credited.

## What is counted

- **Reported doses.** The registry report entries on the earlier course, each showing that Kestrel reported a dose to the state immunization registry, counted only where the entry lies within the credit window (fewer whole calendar months separate its date from today than the window's months).
- **Paid claims.** The paid-claim entries logged against the patient's insurance plans under Prescription Insurance on File: every claim recorded as paid, on any of the patient's coverage records.

## Decision table

| Reported doses within the window | Paid claims compared with reported doses | Kestrel doses credited |
|---|---|---|
| 1 or more | At least as many | Every reported dose |
| 1 or more | Fewer | As many as there are paid claims |
| 0 | Any number | None |

The comparison is inclusive on the "at least as many" side: paid claims equal in number to the reported doses credit every reported dose.

## Worked cases (hypothetical records)

- *Hypothetical 1.* Two registry report entries within the window; the patient's plans show 5 paid claims. 5 is at least 2, so 2 Kestrel doses are credited.
- *Hypothetical 2.* Two registry report entries within the window; the plans show exactly 2 paid claims. 2 is at least 2, so 2 are credited.
- *Hypothetical 3.* Two registry report entries within the window; the plans show 1 paid claim. 1 is fewer than 2, so 1 Kestrel dose is credited.
- *Hypothetical 4.* No registry report entry within the window; the plans show 4 paid claims. No Kestrel dose is credited.

## Basis questions

**Does a dose Kestrel gave but never reported count here?** This rule counts registry report entries; a Kestrel dose with no report entry within the window adds nothing to the reported doses.

**Whose claims are read?** The patient's own paid claims, on every insurance plan the patient holds under Prescription Insurance on File.
